observations: Real native Implement interface inlay rendered after the interface opening brace. Cmd-click invoked typed analysis; Ctrl+I also opened the standard native Implement Methods action.
Interface entry preselected StreamInterface and offered existing Stream or Create new struct. Selected Stream/pointer; actual keyboard Space activated Analyze, enabling Preview.
Diff preview generated Close and Read from embedded io.ReadCloser and preserved the unsaved Unicode comment. Source disk still contained neither that comment nor generated methods.
Apply updated only the native unsaved document. One Cmd+Z removed both methods and restored exact prior source layout while retaining the Unicode edit; Cmd+Shift+Z restored both methods.
Edited the generated TODO bodies in the native editor to implement Read with copy/EOF and Close with nil. Exact native TestStream compiled/reran and passed; Run saved source normally.

From the interface, chose new struct ValueStream and unchecked Pointer receiver. Analysis/preview showed type ValueStream and value receiver Close/Read. Apply, global Undo and Redo preserved existing working Stream implementation.
Native TestStream reran after the new type existed: 1 test passed, exit 0. The unused ValueStream TODO bodies remain explicit panics; no business implementation for them is claimed.

After adding owned navigation fixtures, File > Reload All from Disk loaded those files. Cmd+Shift+T from TestRead showed Choose Test Subject for TestRead (4 found) with Stream.Read, ValueStream.Read, Reader.Read and Writer.Read plus their paths. No null caption.
Selecting Reader.Read navigated to navigation.go at 5:17.
